title: artpipe worker manifest
description: Passed to `codex exec --output-schema` (or the equivalent --output-schema flag on codex_image.py's generate/edit). The worker's FINAL message must match this exactly, no prose around it. The daemon treats this as one input among several — see AGENTS.md's 'Failure is reported, never disguised' and artpiped.py's own re-validation with validate_sprite.py, which is authoritative over this self-report.

id.description: Echoed verbatim from the job's own id — never invented.

out.description: Absolute path to the finished PNG, or null. A missing `out` with status "ok" is the worst outcome available to a worker — verify the file exists before writing "ok".

background_used.description: "transparent" or the hex key actually rendered, e.g. "#10e010".

attempts.description: 1 unless a mechanical validate_sprite.py reject forced a regenerate (up to 3 total) or a tool error/refusal forced one retry.

note.description: What changed from the prompt, or why it failed. A refusal's own words, never paraphrased.
